 1          WHEREAS, the above-captioned Related Cases currently are pending in this District and
 2 concern substantially the same parties, property, transaction, or event;

 3          WHEREAS, the above-captioned matter, McPhee v. Prosper Funding, LLC, was the first-
 4   filed and is the furthest along, procedurally, among the Related Cases;
 5          WHEREAS, the Parties agree that this Stipulation is being entered into without waiving
 6   any party’s rights or ability to raise any defenses or claims (including jurisdictional challenges)
 7   and expressly reserve all rights regarding the same;
 8          WHEREAS, the Parties agree that the Related Cases should be consolidated for pre-trial
 9   purposes in the interests of efficiency and judicial economy, and to avoid unnecessary duplication
10   of effort and resources. Accordingly, all counsel for the Parties to the Related Cases jointly
11   stipulate and request that the Court enter an Order consolidating the Related Cases for pre-trial
12   purposes and permitting the filing of a single Consolidated Class Action Complaint; and
13          WHEREAS, the Parties agree that it would be duplicative and wasteful of the Court’s and
14   the Parties’ resources for Defendants to be required to separately respond to the complaints in the
15   Related Actions prior to the filing of a Consolidated Class Action Complaint, should the Court
16   order the requested consolidation;
17          NOW, THEREFORE, IT IS STIPULATED AND AGREED, and the Parties request,
18   that the Court order the following:
19          1.      The Related Cases are consolidated for all pre-trial purposes (the “Consolidated
20   Action”) pursuant to Fed. R. Civ. P. 42(a).

22   Action” will bear Lead Case 3:25-cv-07947-CRB, the number assigned to the first-filed case and
